goal: When bakeoff show <run-id> detects related escalation children, or shows an escalation run that has siblings, append exactly one concise next-reader hint pointing to bakeoff bundle <source-run-id> with the correct --out value; otherwise leave the normal report output unchanged.
background:
Acceptance criteria:
- Showing a run with one or more escalation children renders exactly one additional next-reader hint line of the form 'bakeoff bundle <source-run-id> --out <out-value>' using the originating source run id and the resolved --out directory.
- Showing an escalation child run that has sibling escalation runs renders exactly one additional next-reader hint line pointing to 'bakeoff bundle <source-run-id> --out <out-value>' for the source run.
- Showing a run with no escalation children and no sibling escalations renders output unchanged from prior behavior (no hint line is added).
- The new hint is the single next-reader recommendation surfaced by show; no competing next-step recommendations are added in the same code path.
- Focused tests in internal/commands/showcmd/show_test.go cover three cases: escalation parent with children present, escalation child with siblings present, and a run with no escalation relations (baseline stability).
- go test ./internal/commands/showcmd ./internal/runlinks ./internal/ledger passes after the change.

Edit boundary:
- internal/commands/showcmd/show.go
- internal/commands/showcmd/show_test.go
- internal/commands/showcmd package helper files only if strictly necessary
Bakeoff will capture candidate patches from isolated worktrees and will not apply them to this checkout.

build.comparison_goal: Prefer the patch that satisfies the acceptance criteria with the smallest maintainable change.
